defects.title: Adding a script argument restores earlier argument text and autosaves the loss
defects.scenario: Editing script argument then adding retains newest text
defects.steps: Seed a script with args=["--version"]. Open its editor. Replace Args 1 with {{ vars.value }} and wait for All changes saved. Without closing the editor, click Add args and enter second in Args 2.
defects.expected: Args 1 stays {{ vars.value }}; autosave stores ["{{ vars.value }}","second"].
defects.actual: Args 1 changes back to --version. The API draft now holds ["--version","second"]. The lost text had already reached the server before Add args. Closing/reloading between editing and adding avoids the reproduction because it changes the form’s initial value.
defects.scope: The array field implementation is unchanged relative to local main. This is a current full-regression defect, not established as introduced by #48.

defects.title: Double-click on a node outside the eventual dialog bounds dismisses its editor immediately
defects.steps: Open a nine-node editor at 1440×900. Double-click a node header near the canvas’s left or right edge (for example wait, or start in a fresh grid).
defects.expected: The repeated activation leaves one editor open and editable.
defects.actual: The first click opens the dialog. The second click lands on its backdrop and closes it. After the double-click there are zero dialogs. A single click works.
defects.scope: Reproduced in both themes. The specification defines single-click and drag behavior; this finding records a usability failure of repeated pointer activation.

defects.title: Loop-variable JSON editor collapses to a sliver and cannot receive an ordinary pointer click
defects.scenario: Variable JSON record editor is reachable by pointer
defects.steps: Expand Loop. In Variables, click Add entry and rename the key to qaValue. Scroll the panel to its bottom and click the JSON value editor.
defects.expected: A readable JSON value editor remains inside the row and accepts pointer focus.
defects.actual: The editor is compressed beside the full-width key input. CodeMirror content measures 31.5 px wide; its centre hits the sibling row instead of the editor, and an ordinary click times out. The visible wrapper is a thin strip. The newly added value remains null and validation blocks saving until a value is entered. Tab/focus plus keyboard entry works; the resulting variable schema saves and reloads.
defects.scope: Record-field implementation is unchanged relative to local main. No attribution to the modal/panel change is claimed.

defects.title: Empty optional heartbeat Until shows a compile-error preview (known D30)
defects.scenario: Blank optional heartbeat expression has no error preview
defects.steps: Open a heartbeat whose Max beats is 3 and whose optional Until field is empty.
defects.expected: The optional empty expression has no failure preview.
defects.actual: The preview says expression failed to compile: Unexpected end of expression. The heartbeat configuration is valid because Max beats is present.
defects.scope: Known D30 from docs/qa/2026-10-03-wp-d2.md; not a newly attributed regression.
